text:
Four test-tubes contain dilute hydrochloric acid. Each test-tube has one piece of a different metal
added to it. The metals are copper, iron, magnesium and zinc.
Which test-tube contains iron and dilute hydrochloric acid?
A
B
C
D
subject: Chemistry
